3. The committee shall be headed by its chairman who
shall be the executive officer of the committee, and will be
empowered to appoint such persons or entities and to issue
such rules and regulations for the purposes of assisting him
in the discharge of his duties and responsibilities and of
implementing the objectives and programs of the com-
4. The chairman is also authorized to call directly upon
any department, bureau, or office of the executive branch
of the government or upon any government-owned or con-
trolled entity or agency for such assistance as the com-
mittee may need and, subject to the approval of the Pres-
ident, to requisition or utilize and make use of the service
of their personnel.
Done in the City of Manila, Philippines, this 8th day of
January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
